deliverables.prompt:
Use case: ui-mockup. Deliver one polished, photorealistic high-fidelity UI design IMAGE for a complete CanveliqSoft product-detail webpage. A tall full-page desktop screenshot, desired 1440 x 3600, portrait, viewed straight on. This is a designed webpage, not an infographic, not a presentation board or device photograph. All ten content blocks and the related-products ending must be visible fully with no clipped footer. Use concise legible text and precise professional typography, generous breathing room. Shared template for four product types.

CANVELIQSOFT VISUAL SYSTEM: restrained premium editorial style. Warm-white / pale lavender #F7F6FC main canvas, deep midnight navy #080F1E header, hero surround and occasional emphasis panels, ink #101A33, electric purple #7952EB, lilac #B99AF7, cyan #00DCEB. Thin lavender borders, very soft colored glows, luminous restrained glass surfaces, crisp controls. Serif display headings with one italic purple phrase; clean modern sans serif UI and body. No beige outer page, no orange brand chrome, no cartoon people, no giant decorative 3D shapes. Rounded corners 16px not excessive pills. Realistically render browser windows and compact responsive previews of the product itself. Design quality comparable to an exceptionally crafted premium software studio.

CONSISTENT LAYOUT: compact midnight navigation top with the supplied CanveliqSoft wordmark at left and Home, Solutions, Collection (active), ERP, Work, The Minds; small cyan Let's talk button. An elegant slim left progress rail with numbers 01–10 and short section names, active purple dot and fine connecting line. Main content comfortably inset from rail. Ten numbered sections in the EXACT order below. Two-column compositions inside each section are allowed, but do not put different numbered sections side by side. One restrained visual number/eyebrow per section, larger display titles. Alternate light canvas and a few dark navy inset panels. All labels, buttons and content must be real legible text, no lorem ipsum. Bottom floating glass action bar visually separate from content, left product name and Concept/Demo status, right heart Save and cyan Discuss this solution arrow. No fake testimonials, ratings, customers, measured benefits, logos of clients, or guarantees.

PRODUCT: StockFlow. Retail & commerce / Software / status "Concept preview".
01 Heading "StockFlow" italic "Every item. In focus." One-line promise "A clearer view of stock, orders and your next move."
02 Large believable dark inventory dashboard browser on navy surface, Inventory / Orders / Customers sidebar, attractive cyan and purple bars, sample metrics Products 842, Orders 128, Low stock 12. Compact stock table Ceramic mug / Linen tote / Desk lamp with In stock and Reorder pills. A floating small mobile inventory panel and cyan "Try sample" button. Caption "Illustrative interface · Sample data".
03 Audience "For independent shops and growing retail teams". Three problems "Stock hidden in spreadsheets", "Orders hard to follow", "Reorders left too late". Shared Fit check: team 6–20 / website Yes / priority Stock clarity.
04 Outcomes "Know your stock at a glance", "Follow every order", "Spot what needs restocking".
05 Clear module checklist "Inventory overview", "Order tracking", "Customer records", "Low-stock alerts", "CSV reports". Not included "Payment processing", "Custom integrations", "Migration unless agreed". Subtle module grid icons and a product mini preview.
06 EMPHASISE with an interactive scenario panel: top "Before: scattered stock sheets". Clickable ordered steps "01 Receive stock" → "02 Record a sale" → "03 See stock update" → "04 Review reorder list"; show sample sale of 3 Ceramic mugs updating quantity 24 → 21, cyan chart and "Simulate a sale" button. Label "Interactive concept · No live business data". Bottom "After: one clear stock picture".
07 Discover → Configure → Test → Handover. "Example rollout: 1–3 weeks · Scope dependent". Documentation and guided setup callouts.
08 "Monthly / indicative plan" large "$29–$79 / month", adjacent "Illustrative subscription range". Price drivers "Team size · Store locations · Integrations". "Availability, support and final pricing confirmed before purchase".
09 Four concise trust details: Licence "Business subscription, terms agreed"; Support "Coverage confirmed with your plan"; Requirements "Modern browser + internet"; Data "Import and export scope agreed". Small "Related real project: Maison Velour · Explore the retail experience ↗" with text-only link, no implication StockFlow is used by Maison.
10 "Bring your stock into focus." Cyan "Discuss this solution" plus Save and green WhatsApp Ask a question. Brief preview "I'd like StockFlow for my retail team. My priority is stock clarity." Related cards "Commerce UI Kit" and "Retail ERP".
Bottom sticky bar StockFlow / Concept preview. No Buy button or claims that this concept is already available.

02 Large realistic dark chat-support dashboard browser with Knowledge / Conversations / Handover sidebar, elegant visitor conversation and small mobile companion. Visitor "Do you deliver outside Dhaka?" assistant "I can help you check the store's published delivery information." Show a suggestion chip "Talk to a person" and source tag "Store delivery guide". Under Bangla sample visitor "ডেলিভারি কত দিনে হবে?" assistant "আপনার ঠিকানা জানালে টিমকে প্রশ্নটি পাঠাতে পারি।" Label "Sample conversation · No live order access".
